title: Looking For Her
content: I have been dreaming about Mallworld for as long as I can remember. And for as long as I've been dreaming about Mallworld, I've dreamt about this girl. She is always nondescript but I know it is the same girl—she's been there every time I go to Mallworld. She's beautiful, funny, and indescribably *real*. Every time I see her, it is a feeling that can't be put into words—the love I feel when I see her, when I hold her, when I adventure Mallworld alongside her. I have always felt deep down that she wasn't just a dream NPC and when I found out about this sub—it just confirmed to me that she could be as real as you or I. So knowing this, I have begun my hunt for this elusive girl, this unreachable angel that I yearn for and miss every time I wake. If you have been adventuring alongside a female in Mallworld for years and have a deep, innate yearning for her—that could be me and I have been looking for you too. Until we meet again tonight, Mary. ❤️
